name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

overview: A flagship skill certification scheme enabling youth to take up industry-relevant short-term skill training and get certified, improving their employability and livelihood options.
objectives: Provide industry-relevant skill training to youth
Enable certification and recognition of prior learning
Improve employability and entrepreneurship among trained youth

benefits.title: Free Skill Training
benefits.description: Short-term training programmes in various industry-relevant job roles, free of cost

benefits.title: Certification
benefits.description: Nationally recognised skill certification upon successful assessment

otherCriteria: Indian youth, including school/college dropouts and unemployed persons

customQuestions.question: Are you between 15 and 45 years of age?
Are you a school/college dropout, out-of-education youth, or unemployed youth?
Are you willing to undergo an eligible PMKVY skill-training course/job role?
Do you satisfy the educational/qualification requirements of the selected job role?
Is the selected job role/course available at an approved PMKVY training centre/Skill Hub?
Can you provide the required Aadhaar/identity and registration details for enrolment?
Are you willing to complete the prescribed training and assessment/certification requirements?
If the selected course has additional job-role-specific eligibility requirements, do you satisfy them?

applicationProcess.description: Register at nearest PMKVY training centre or via Skill India portal
Undergo training in selected job role

faqs.question: Is PMKVY training free?
faqs.answer: Yes, training is provided free of cost to candidates.

faqs.question: Is there a placement guarantee?
faqs.answer: Placement assistance is provided but not guaranteed.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

overview: A scheme to promote apprenticeship training in the country by providing financial incentives to establishments engaging apprentices under the Apprentices Act.
objectives: Provide financial support to employers and basic training providers
Bridge the gap between industry skill needs and workforce readiness

benefits.title: Stipend Support
benefits.description: Government reimburses a share of the stipend paid to apprentices

benefits.title: Basic Training Cost Support
benefits.description: Reimbursement for basic training costs to establishments

otherCriteria: Candidates engaged as apprentices with registered establishments under the Apprentices Act

customQuestions.question: Do you satisfy the minimum age requirement prescribed for the apprenticeship trade?
Do you satisfy the educational qualification prescribed for the selected trade?
Do you satisfy the required physical/medical qualification, where prescribed for the trade?
Are you registered on the official apprenticeship portal?
Do you have an Aadhaar number?

If you are applying as a fresher apprentice, are you within the applicable age limit for a fresher?  Yes / No / Not Applicable  Yes, if applicable  7  Are you applying for an apprenticeship in an eligible designated or optional trade?
Have you found/been selected by an establishment offering an apprenticeship seat in the relevant trade?

applicationProcess.description: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal
Get engaged as apprentice with a registered establishment

faqs.question: Who benefits from NAPS?
faqs.answer: Both apprentices and establishments engaging them receive support.

faqs.question: What is reimbursed under NAPS?
faqs.answer: A share of stipend and basic training cost for apprentices.

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) Scheme

ministry.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

overview: A scheme providing vocational skills to non-literate, neo-literate and school dropouts, especially in rural areas, through Jan Shikshan Sansthans located across the country.
objectives: Provide vocational skills to non-literate and marginalised populations
Focus on women, SC/ST, minorities and rural youth
Improve livelihoods through low-cost, localised training

benefits.title: Vocational Training
benefits.description: Skill training in trades suited to local employment opportunities, largely free or heavily subsidised

otherCriteria: Non-literate, neo-literate and school dropouts, especially women and marginalised groups aged 15-45

customQuestions.question: Are you between 15 and 45 years of age?
Are you a non-literate, neo-literate or person with rudimentary education?
Are you a school dropout up to Class XII?
Are you a graduate seeking skill-development training?
Are you willing to undergo skill training through a JSS?
Do you belong to a priority/disadvantaged group, such as women, SC, ST, OBC, minorities or another disadvantaged group?

If you are a Divyangjan or another deserving case, do you qualify for applicable age relaxation?  Yes / No / Not Applicable  Yes, if applicable  8  Are you seeking training for self-employment or wage employment?

applicationProcess.description: Contact the nearest Jan Shikshan Sansthan
Enrol in a suitable vocational training course

faqs.question: Who can enrol in JSS courses?
faqs.answer: Primarily non-literate, neo-literate and school dropouts, especially in rural and marginalised communities.

faqs.question: Is there a fee for training?
faqs.answer: Training is largely free or available at nominal cost.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
overview: A placement-linked skill development scheme for rural poor youth aimed at diversifying incomes of rural poor families and catering to the career aspirations of rural youth.
objectives: Provide placement-linked skill training to rural poor youth
Diversify income sources for rural households
Enhance social and financial inclusion of rural youth

benefits.title: Free Residential Training
benefits.description: Skill training with free boarding and lodging for eligible candidates

benefits.title: Placement Assistance
benefits.description: Guaranteed placement support post training completion

otherCriteria: Rural youth from poor families as identified under the scheme criteria

customQuestions.question: Are you between 15 and 35 years of age?
Do you belong to a rural area/rural household?
Do you belong to a poor/disadvantaged rural household covered by the DDU-GKY beneficiary criteria?
Are you willing to undergo skill training under an approved DDU-GKY project/training centre?
Do you satisfy the educational requirements of the selected course/job role?
Are you willing to complete the prescribed training, assessment and certification?
Are you seeking wage employment or self-employment-oriented skill training?
If the selected training programme has additional job-role-specific requirements, do you satisfy them?

applicationProcess.description: Register at DDU-GKY training centre or through the portal
Undergo skill training as per selected job role

faqs.question: Is training residential?
faqs.answer: Yes, residential training with free boarding and lodging is provided for eligible candidates.

faqs.question: Is placement guaranteed?
faqs.answer: The scheme mandates minimum placement rates for training partners.

name: Craftsmen Training Scheme (ITI - Craftsman Training)

ministry.name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

overview: A scheme to train school leavers and other candidates through Industrial Training Institutes in various engineering and non-engineering trades, providing recognised craftsman certificates.
objectives: Develop skilled workforce for industry through structured ITI training
Improve employability of trained candidates in relevant industries

benefits.title: Structured Technical Training
benefits.description: Trade-specific training of 6 months to 2 years leading to a National Trade Certificate

education: Minimum Class VIII/X pass depending on trade

applicationProcess.description: Apply for admission through state ITI counselling portal
Undergo trade training at the ITI
Appear for All India Trade Test for certification

faqs.question: What certificate is awarded?
faqs.answer: A National Trade Certificate recognised across India.

faqs.question: What is the duration of training?
faqs.answer: Ranges from 6 months to 2 years depending on the trade.
